verdict.rationale: Spline ships an official MCP server (bundled in the desktop app) that lets Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, etc. drive the Spline editor directly, and it offers a Code API/exports for programmatic scene access — but this is a 3D scene design tool, not a UI/design-system source, so there is no evidence of pulling 'frames, variables, screenshots, component mappings' in the sense of a design-context handoff (e.g. Figma-like design tokens or screen frames) for an agent to implement a UI design. missing for 10: evidence of frame/screenshot export via MCP or API, variable/token extraction for implementation, component-to-code mapping beyond generic React/Three.js export, and independent hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's design-context fidelity.
